en.title: European Accessibility Act Enforced; US Firms Gain Compliance Framework
en.summary: The European Accessibility Act has begun enforcement, prompting accessiBe to offer a compliance framework for US businesses. Meanwhile, New Mexico advocates call for an Office of Accessibility, and Kingston residents raise concerns about sidewalk accessibility improvements. Additional updates include a new accessibility report for the game Teardown and a guide on using Lighthouse to enhance web performance and accessibility.

highlights.title: The European Accessibility Act Is Now Being Enforced and accessiBe Has a Framework for US Businesses
Why New Mexico needs an Office of Accessibility now

zh-TW.title: 歐洲無障礙法案開始執行，accessiBe 提供美國企業合規框架
zh-TW.summary: 歐洲無障礙法案已開始實施，accessiBe 提供一個框架幫助美國企業符合數位無障礙需求。同時，新墨西哥州倡議成立無障礙辦公室，金斯頓居民在人行道改善會議上表達無障礙關注。其他更新包括促進包容性水上活動的社群訊號，以及《Teardown》遊戲的無障礙報告。
